# OutVenture Media

> A Kauaʻi production company making films, photos and reels for adventure and tourism brands, and running the social channels that carry them to the booking. Founded by Sareh Michelle, a former Kauaʻi tour guide. Based on Kauaʻi, shoots across the Hawaiian islands and travels for the right story.

Contact: contact@getgrowing.marketing. Offers: half-day shoot, single-day shoot, multi-day production, social media management (retainer), influencer management. Signature method: Reels to Reservations.

- [Outfitters Kauaʻi: Organized shoot](https://outventure.media/portfolio/outfitters-kauai/): A planned shoot with Outfitters Kauaʻi, capturing their zipline and adventure tours with the guides who run them. A story film is planned next.
- [Hoʻomalu Ke Kai: Coral restoration series](https://outventure.media/portfolio/hoomalu-ke-kai/): A story-driven series on coral restoration with Hoʻomalu Ke Kai, built on pre-production and told through the people doing the work.
- [Shoots and films first](https://outventure.media/services/): Half-day, single-day and multi-day video productions for tour operators and adventure brands in Hawaiʻi, plus social media management and influencer management.
- [Half-day shoot](https://outventure.media/services/half-day-shoot/): We join one of your tours and capture what happens, with no heavy staging. Fresh footage and a first look at working with OutVenture Media.
- [Single-day shoot](https://outventure.media/services/single-day-shoot/): One planned day with a small crew and cast, built on a brief, script and shot list, for a hero film or a campaign of content.
- [Multi-day production](https://outventure.media/services/multi-day-production/): Multiple days and locations with a full crew and cast, planned end to end, for operators and brands telling a larger story.
- [Social media management](https://outventure.media/services/social-media-management/): Social media marketing and management for Hawaiʻi tour operators: planning, scheduling, captions and partnerships, so the film you invest in keeps earning bookings.
- [Influencer management](https://outventure.media/services/influencer-management/): Influencer and creator management for tourism operators: we find the creators, run the collaboration from first message to final post, and track what it brings in.
- [Reels to Reservations](https://outventure.media/reels-to-reservations/): The system OutVenture Media developed for tourism marketing: each reel built around the moment a guest would pay to feel, then connected to the booking path.
- [A Kauaʻi videographer who has worked the tours](https://outventure.media/kauai-videographer/): A Kauaʻi videographer and video production company for tour operators and brands across Hawaiʻi: films, reels and photos shot on the tour by a former guide.
- [A Hawaiʻi videographer for tour operators and brands](https://outventure.media/hawaii-videographer/): A Hawaiʻi videographer for tour operators and activity brands: brand films, reels and photos shot on the tour, across Kauaʻi, Oʻahu, Maui and the Big Island.
- [A tourism marketing agency that makes the content first](https://outventure.media/hawaii-tourism-marketing-agency/): A Hawaiʻi tourism marketing agency that makes the content first: films, reels and photos for tour operators, then the social media management that books them.
